subject: คณิตศาสตร์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: Sharp cyclic fraction bound from Cauchy and AM–GM
units.statement: For positive a,b,c,x,y with abc=P, the expression (x+y)(a²+b²+c²)[a⁵/(xc+yb)+b⁵/(xa+yc)+c⁵/(xb+ya)] is at least 9P², with equality at a=b=c=P^(1/3). Normalize x+y=1. Cauchy bounds the fraction sum by (a^(5/2)+b^(5/2)+c^(5/2))²/(a+b+c); AM–GM makes the numerator at least 9P^(5/3), and power-mean plus AM–GM gives (a²+b²+c²)/(a+b+c)≥P^(1/3).
steps: Normalize the two denominator weights by x+y
Apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the three fractions
Use AM–GM and the root-mean-square inequality, then check equality
